name: Stonehollow
description: An orange dwarf over a hollowed rock, a metal belt, and a dwarf companion in the sparse halo. The hollow mines run deeper than any others. Everything extracted here leaves by mass driver.

stars.name: Stonehollow Glow
stars.description: A steady orange dwarf with a calm output the deep mines depend on. Its light reaches the pit bottoms only by mirror relay. The miners toast it on every shift change.

planets.name: Hollow
planets.description: A honeycombed rock mined hollow over centuries, its tunnels now towns. The deepest levels run warm from the planet's own heat. Guides lead tours through the oldest galleries.

dwarfPlanets.name: Tailings
dwarfPlanets.description: A rocky dwarf built substantially from the Hollow's own tailings, towed outward over decades. It is the only world with a documented construction date. Engineers visit it as a pilgrimage.

belts.name: Hollow Belt
belts.description: A metal-rich main belt feeding the hollow mines with fresh ore. Claim frames here are inherited, not bought. The assay office answers to the miners' council.
